subject: DPIA: escrow snapshot, transfer-assurance artifacts & audit logistics
messages:
From: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@bancnord.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal Ops <legalops@bancnord.com>, Audit Team <audit@trustcompliance.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -0400
Subject: DPIA artifacts & escrow snapshot request

Hi Karthik,

As part of our onboarding checklist and internal DPIA review, BancNord's legal and audit teams need a consolidated evidence pack covering:
- Article 30 processing register export
- Subprocessor inventory and transfer mechanisms (SCCs / Standard contractual terms)
- DPIA summary and mitigations for model inference (data flow diagrams preferred)
- KMS key custody and rotation proof (hash/manifest acceptable)
- An escrow snapshot of the deployed inference artifacts (we will provide the escrow provider contact)

Can you confirm the estimated timeline to provide these (we're aiming to complete the DPIA by 2026-10-11)? Also please include any playbook or access instructions you expect the escrow provider to follow.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Nguyen
Senior Counsel, Data Protection
BancNord

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@bancnord.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: DPIA artifacts & escrow snapshot request

Sara — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Marissa (privacy) and Lauren (security/compliance ops) to coordinate the pack and escrow logistics. High level:

- We can produce an Article 30 register extract and a DPIA summary within 5 business days.
- Subprocessor inventory and signed SCC templates: we will provide the inventory and copies of existing SCCs where applicable; new cross-border transfers can be scoped in parallel.
- KMS proof: Security can provide rotation logs and a signed manifest; if you prefer a hash, we can include a checksum file.
- Escrow snapshot: we typically work with third-party escrow providers for deployment snapshots. Please share your escrow provider contact; we can coordinate a secure snapshot transfer and an access audit trail.

Next steps: Marissa — can your team compile the DPIA summary + processing register export? Lauren — can you give an ETA for the KMS rotation evidence and the technical instructions we should give the escrow provider? Ben — once we have the list, please prepare a one-page delivery checklist and a Drive folder with access controls.

Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@bancnord.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 11:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: DPIA artifacts & escrow snapshot request

Hi all — quick update from privacy:

What we'll deliver (target: 2026-10-06)
- redwood_dpia_summary.pdf — concise DPIA summary focused on inference flows, retention windows, and risk mitigations.
- processing_register_art30.csv — export of the Article 30 register filtered for BancNord scope.
- subprocessor_inventory_20260930.xlsx — latest inventory with legal basis and transfer mechanism column.

Notes / clarifications
- For SCCs: we can attach the executed templates we use with cloud infra providers. If BancNord requires a signed addendum for a specific subprocessor, flag which vendor and contract id and we'll prioritize.
- DPIA diagrams: two PNGs will be included (in the Drive link) showing network ingress/egress and pseudonymization points.

Attachments: we will place the files in a restricted Drive folder and share the link to Audit Team and BancNord Legal. Ben — can you add the Drive link to this thread once created?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Privacy Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: James O'Leary <james.oleary@escrowvault.io>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@bancnord.com>
Cc: Audit Team <audit@trustcompliance.com>
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: DPIA artifacts & escrow snapshot request

Hi Karthik / Sara — James from EscrowVault here. BancNord asked us to manage the snapshot transfer and time-boxed access for the audit team. We can perform the following:

- Secure snapshot (containerized artifacts + manifest) captured from the environment at an agreed UTC time.
- Deliver the snapshot to our isolated vault and provide read-only, time-limited access for the auditors.
- Provide a transfer log (signed) and a tamper-evidence hash for the package.

Action items for Redwood: please provide the snapshot instructions template (we use this to validate runbook steps) and a target window for the capture. We will generate a DocuSign envelope for escrow account access and a unique retrieval token.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/secure-envelope/ABC-ESCROW-2026

Regards,
James O'Leary
Head of Partnerships, EscrowVault

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@bancnord.com>, James O'Leary <james.oleary@escrowvault.io>

Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2026 14:28:00 -0400
Subject: Re: DPIA artifacts & escrow snapshot request

Thanks everyone — quick confirmation and timeline:

- Privacy (Marissa) will upload redwood_dpia_summary.pdf, processing_register_art30.csv, and subprocessor_inventory_20260930.xlsx to a restricted Drive folder by EOD 2026-10-06. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-dpia-pack
- Security (Lauren) will export KMS rotation evidence and kms_key_rotation_report.txt by 2026-10-05 and will provide the snapshot runbook template for EscrowVault.
- Escrow capture window: proposed 2026-10-08 02:00 UTC (low-traffic); James, confirm if that works and we'll complete the DocuSign flow.
- Ben will assemble a one-page delivery checklist and confirm HubSpot deal HB-4472-BANCNORD is updated with the evidence pack link.

Sara — please confirm the escrow window and the auditors who need access. Once DocuSign is complete we'll initiate the snapshot and share the tamper-evidence hash with BancNord Legal and TrustCompliance.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
